name: Tectra
description: The Latch identity, mineral surfaces, restrained teal and clean utility typography of the Tectra family.
identityNote: The approved Latch keeps its original open geometry with corrected cut angles. Its symbol, horizontal lockup and mineral-teal palette form one identity across Tectra interfaces, adapters and documentation.
assetNote: Use the supplied Latch and lockups. Platform icons, an optical small-size redraw and identity animation remain separate future deliverables.
